title: Cultured butter
creator: chef.sam.black

items.note: fresh, finely chopped, for compound butter

steps: Mix the cream and yogurt, cover with a clean cloth and leave at room temperature for 24–36 hours, until thick and pleasantly sour.
Chill for at least 4–5 hours, preferably overnight.
Churn with a stand mixer, whisk or even a spoon until the butter separates from the buttermilk.
Drain off the buttermilk and keep it for pancakes, baking and marinades.
Wash the butter in ice-cold water, kneading and changing the water until it runs clear.
Salt to taste, shape, and wrap in greaseproof paper. Keep in the fridge or freeze.
notes: Nutrition counts all the cream, though part of it ends up in the buttermilk.
